subject: Your AI-Watch password has been reset
title: Password reset
subtitle: A new temporary password has been issued.
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset your AI-Watch password. Your new temporary password is:

{{tempPassword}}

⚠️ Please change this password from your profile as soon as you log in. If you didn't request this reset, contact your administrator immediately.

Sign in to AI-Watch
